name: SMSOL (Searchable Multi-Select Option List)
description: provides a searchable multi-select option list widget.
project_description:
## INTRODUCTION

 Searchable Multi-select option list with the help of the jQuery plugin which enhances your

 HTML elements and makes the options searchable. 

 HTML

 Configuration settings url is "/admin/config/system/sol-settings"

 ## What are the benefits of using this module?

 
 fully searchable options 
 various types of loading the data 
 easy to use multi select (no Ctrl press needed) 
 fully stylable with CSS
